About us:Welcome to Crowne Plaza Amsterdam – South, a modern business hotel in the lively Zuidas district. With 207 rooms, 7 meeting venues, and buzzing spots like De Japanner Zuid and the Manhattan Lounge-Bar, we offer guests and team members a place to connect, grow, and belong — as part of the global IHG Hotels & Resorts family.Your day to day:You will be the face of our bar experience — combining efficiency, product knowledge, and genuine hospitality to create memorable moments for every guest. You'll work closely with the wider F&B team to ensure smooth, high-quality service in the Manhattan Lounge Bar and beyond.Your responsibilities will include:
• Welcoming guests and creating a friendly, relaxed atmosphere at the bar and lounge 
• Taking orders and serving beverages and light food with professionalism and attention to detail 
• Supporting bartenders by preparing and delivering drinks efficiently and accurately 
• Providing menu knowledge, including drink recommendations and promotions 
• Ensuring tables and bar areas are clean, organized, and well-presented at all times 
• Handling payments and billing procedures, including cash and card transactions 
• Assisting with stock replenishment and maintaining bar supplies 
• Coordinating with bartenders and restaurant colleagues for seamless service 
• Maintaining hygiene and safety standards (HACCP, Fire Life Safety, Green Engage) 
• Being attentive and proactive in anticipating guest needs

Functie-eisen:
What we need from you:
• Previous experience in hospitality, bar service, or F&B is an advantage 
• Passion for beverages, with an interest in cocktails and bar culture 
• Strong communication skills in English; Dutch or additional languages are a plus 
• A natural host — service-minded, outgoing, and enthusiastic 
• Well-groomed appearance and professional attitude 
• Ability to multitask and stay calm in a fast-paced environment 
• Eye for detail and commitment to quality service 
•

 - 
Join our team as a warehouse employee at Zara in Rotterdam Zuidplein, right in the heart of the city. This role offers 3 to 8 hours per week, with shifts on Monday and Thursday mornings from 7:00 to 10:00 or 11:00. It's perfect for those seeking flexible work alongside studies or another job. You'll ensure deliveries are processed efficiently, unpack boxes, sort clothing and accessories, and organize them in the warehouse. Maintaining an overview, you'll collaborate with your team to keep the store stocked. After your shift, you'll help tidy the warehouse, staying active and working closely with colleagues. No experience? No problem! With a positive attitude, motivation, and enthusiasm, you'll fit right in. Apply now and discover the excitement of working in fashion logistics! 
 Wij bieden - 
 - Salary: €14.99 per hour; - 3 to 8 hours per week; - Temporary contract with the possibility of extension; - Work in an enthusiastic team; - Pleasant working environment in the city center; - Opportunities for growth within the company; - Good guidance and a positive atmosphere; - Access to staff discount on fashion items. 
 Wij vragen - 
 - At least VMBO-level (secondary education) working and thinking level; - Experience is not required, but is a plus; - Able to work independently and in a team; - Physically fit and proactive; - You speak Dutch or English. 
Neem dan contact met ons op via: +31165326005 
 Waar ga je werken?
